summary: Montenegrin-born psychiatrist and poet Radovan Karadžić led the Bosnian Serbs during the 1992-95 war, directing the siege of Sarajevo and the Srebrenica genocide, then hid in Belgrade as a New Age healer until his 2008 arrest.

evidence.note: born June 1945 in Pejica, Montenegro; earlier Balkan and WWII material is background
allowed to study at Columbia in New York, 1974-75; short US segment
works as psychiatrist in Sarajevo and as Red Star team psychologist; 1985 fraud conviction
1990: forms the SDS on anti-Muslim, anti-Croat lines; start of main span
Bosnian Serb militias seize land after the referendum, Republika Srpska declared, he heads it
Mladic as his military chief; host says he died weeks before recording
Srebrenica executions of over 8,000 Bosniak men and boys, mass graves hidden
NATO, Delta Force, CIA and MI6 manhunt led by Petraeus fails to find him
lives in Belgrade as Dragan Dabic, energy healer, pendulum, homeopathy, sperm healing
2008 arrest, Hague trial, 2016 conviction for genocide; end of main span

notes: Opening ~25 min of Part 1 (Ottoman rule, WWI, Ustase/Chetniks, father's 1930s killing of a cousin) treated as background, so covered starts at birth; reviewer may extend to ~1930s. Host says Mladic died weeks before recording (2026); I could not confirm, end year follows transcript. Host gives the 2016 40-year sentence and omits the later appeal to life. Fascism-far-right used for Serb ethno-nationalism; no specific theme for it.
